attBesluta.text: I love this multi position ladder. It helps me traverse a short free stacked stone wall and work around the house.
Très bonne qualité et très polyvalent, Pratique à manipuler: je recommande!

A good purchase. I would have liked a bit taller than I ordered. Functionally it has exceeded my expectations. I am for reference 285lbs and ladder was stable as I did my eaves trough. I used the scaffold function to paint at my camp. No wobble from ladder as I walked across and stood at all sections to paint. I also use the scaffold function as a work bench and it worked quite well. I'm not sure on the stair scaffold as I'm am not sure whether to put folded leg on step although I'm can see no other way. I have reached out to vevor regarding this but to date have received no guidance. All in all I am happy with purchase.I would recommend this ladder.
Sturdy and versatile. A little narrow but not terribly so. Used it the day I received it. Love it.
Getting on my roof, trimming my tall bushes, exactly what I needed!!!!
Unfolding is a bit difficult but other than that it's nice and sturdy

This piece was very well priced for the amount of work I can get out of it. It's a solid ladder. It's tall so it'll reach the top of your roof. Does a fold where you can do a half fold and you have two sides with stairs on it. It's a really great purchase

Excellent quality, excellent price and quick delivery. I made a TikTok video @hisgraceevents. This is the third time I ordered from vevor and do not regret it. Excellent prices on everything. Thank you!!
Awsome company. Very customer service oriented. Definitely will be back to do.more business with them.
These are easy to install, work well, and clean easy.
Excellent product. Really add sophistication to events.
I took it to shallow beach water and damp grass. The search coil holds up well to splashes and light rain, no signal drops when hunting near water.
Larger scan area means I cover more terrain in less time. Great for scanning big beach stretches quickly.
Works great under leaf litter and soft forest soil, picks up small metal items hidden under fallen branches.

he tenido que comprar este colector de acero inoxidable de mucha mas calidad que el Kit de Tradesa-Eurotherm que lo fabrican en poliamida y se rompe con mirarlo. Este Colector tiene muy buen calidad y además es más económico que el de Eurotherm; trae en el kit las llaves de corte, termometros, purgador y conexiones para tubo multicapa... todo incluido, es magnifico. Compre el de Eurotherm pensando que al ser de poliamida tendría menos perdidas por calor y me equivoqué, cuando lo instalas se rompe y pierde agua... una basura
